name: Pixel Buds
author: Ryan Doupe
description: Pixel Buds Pro in the Omarchy bar: battery per bud and case, listening modes, shared volume with swipe OSD, touch gestures, and device + sound controls (multipoint, speech detection, EQ, balance). Event-driven: the icon appears the moment your buds connect. Omarchy-native: a bundled Python bridge talks to the buds directly, so nothing else needs installing.

barWidget.description: Battery, listening modes, shared volume with swipe OSD, touch gestures, and advanced sound controls.
